prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §547.501, what distance must a motor vehicle horn be audible under normal conditions?

options.text: Audible under normal conditions from a distance of at least 200 feet
Audible under normal conditions from a distance of at least 50 feet
Audible under normal conditions from a distance of at least 500 feet
Audible under normal conditions from a distance of at least 1,000 feet
